acceptance: Large and unknown specialized surfaces fall back without false semantics, source corruption or unbounded memory.

positive.fixture: 200000 lines of terminal output keep 1016 rows and about 1 MB of heap growth; 2 MB lines, 1 MB of invalid bytes, extreme cursor moves, 5000 alternate-screen toggles and 50000 titles leave the terminal responsive; 40 open and dispose cycles grow the heap under 1 MB; a 3.5 MB, 100000-line document draws 67 lines and edits stay exact; odd text round-trips unchanged

negative.fixture: canvas and image charts, charts over 100000 marks and manifests with no usable transport are unsupported with a reason and keep the source interface; no surface is guessed
negative.command: pnpm --filter @vsf/specialized exec node --conditions=source --test --test-reporter=spec --test-name-pattern=canvas and image|more marks than|nothing is usable|declares a transport unavailable test/chart.test.ts test/transport.test.ts

security_and_source_permissions: Hostile output cannot retitle the page, navigate or open windows; text with bidirectional controls, NUL and stacked combining marks round-trips through the editor unchanged.
performance_memory_storage: Heap budgets asserted: 16 MB (flood), 16 MB (hostile), 8 MB (40 cycles), 64 MB (3.5 MB document); measured about 1 MB, 0.6 MB, 0.9 MB and 23.5 MB.
known_limitations: Budgets cover Chromium 141 on Linux only
A canvas-based terminal or editor surface in a source page is not recognized, so it keeps the source interface
Measured on a CI-class container; no phone or low-memory device was tested
